title: Human Index photographic portfolio layout
intent: Photography changes the portfolio's editorial rhythm while remaining public-safe, accessible, and subordinate to human publication authority.

criteria.criterion: Every field photograph is registered once in the public manifest with stable dimensions, alt text, caption, credit, placement, status, and boundary.

The launch candidate uses exactly six fully bound, credited, Jamie-authorized field derivatives: the unchanged East River hero, three destination-reviewed NYC Artist Coalition occurrences, the Sunday Dinner cover, and the KC Town Hall cover; additional curated leads remain private pending exact rights, dignity, and attribution review.
Public assets and source code contain no EXIF payload, private archive UUID, original camera filename, or protected filesystem path.

The East River hero remains unchanged; two restrained field-and-system pairs make implementation legible on the homepage and Fair Rent case study, while About and Colophon remain text-led. On the homepage, the connective passage follows the selected projects so it synthesizes the work without repeating the opening project image back to back.

The Source-Backed Team Memory lab uses the governed NYC Artist Coalition card-field occurrence to show collective knowledge becoming navigable without implying that the structure created the knowledge, proving later software architecture, or assigning sole authorship.

Every work item has exactly one project-specific visual cover: Fair Rent NYC, Sunday Dinner, and KC Town Hall use governed photographs; Harry J. Epstein, KC Spaces Fund, CallNYC, and WOW List use their own public surfaces while private photo leads await exact clearance.

The six-project homepage sequence makes one hiring argument for the current product, operations, implementation, and civic-technology opportunity set: current NYC civic delivery, sustained accountable operations, and resident-facing product judgment lead the scan; municipal implementation, a community platform operating across 35+ city ecosystems, and recurring participation infrastructure complete it. Sunday Dinner remains visible, while KC Spaces Fund remains available through the complete work index.

The homepage limits its quick path and proof strip to three high-signal choices each, routes the primary hero action directly to role-fit evidence, retains one field-and-system connective passage, and does not repeat that operating thesis in a second transformation section.
Known creators are named only when confirmed; otherwise photographs use the responsible project's courtesy credit without archive-process prose.

Every tag-shaped control and every homepage capability row is a keyboard-reachable link to a visible filtered work-index state using the canonical project-tag taxonomy, and the filtered state has a clear route back to the complete index.
The Human Index palette is active and gradients, decorative orbs, and bokeh are absent.
Images use Next Image, explicit intrinsic dimensions or fill, stable aspect ratios, responsive sizes, and a viewport-bounded hero.
The design documentation states that automated scores and staging review do not replace human rights or production approval.
